mapper.sql: id, key_id, hostname, version, languages, max_concurrency, running_tasks, isolate_version, status, last_heartbeat_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM judge_nodes ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO judge_nodes (id, key_id, hostname, version, languages, max_concurrency, running_tasks, isolate_version, status, last_heartbeat_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{keyId}, #{hostname}, #{version}, #{languages}, #{maxConcurrency}, #{runningTasks}, #{isolateVersion}, #{status}, #{lastHeartbeatAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE judge_nodes SET key_id = #{keyId}, hostname = #{hostname}, version = #{version}, languages = #{languages}, max_concurrency = #{maxConcurrency}, running_tasks = #{runningTasks}, isolate_version = #{isolateVersion}, status = #{status}, last_heartbeat_at = #{lastHeartbeatAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
